provenance.counts: latest positive manual MCU AADF 2015–2025 excluding 2020; residential/unclassified
provenance.matching: nearest row <=12 m; no other class within 20 m; >30 m from square edge; source 11
provenance.model: S2p: T[cell] * (through ? c : 1) + k * max_street(routed trips); structures_v5 storeys
provenance.holdout: qm-holdout-v1/{x}/{y}: sha256 first 8 hex digits modulo 5 == 0 excluded before extraction
provenance.objective: least squares on ln(AADF); positive parameters via exponential transform
provenance.cv: five folds by sha256(w3-cv/{x}/{y}) first 8 hex digits modulo 5; no model selection
